text:
Eli: Sunday kickoff watch party? Couch league bragging rights on the line.
Noemi: In. I brought a folding fan and questionable optimism.
Harper: Quick prop: $1 that there will be at least one yellow card in first half. whos taking it?
Zain: Ill take it. also I demand a BBQ skewer as trophy for the winner.
Marta: I will craft the skewer with tiny flags. this is official.
Eli: Vote: open seating or assigned couch spots? react with :couch: for open, :anchor: for assigned.
Noemi: :couch:
Harper: :anchor: (I like my spot)
Zain: :couch: (chaos)
OpsBot: Room "Lounge" reserved 16:30-19:00 for "Couch League Watch"  organizer: Eli.
Noemi: Also mini karaoke if game goes to penalties. whos brave? I nominate Harper.
Harper: I accept but only if the song is "We Will Rock You" and only the stamping part.
Zain: Ill bring the tiny cowbell. mandatory for penalty karaoke.
Marta: Prop pool update: Yellow card side bets $1 each. Current takers: Zain (yes), Eli (no), Noemi (yes), Harper (no).
Eli: Anyone streaming for remote Laurie? last-minute link pls.
Harper: stream link: https://watch.example/sundaykick (pw: redwood) pinned.
Noemi: Quick logistics: if winner claims the BBQ skewer, please do not spear any laptops. learned that lesson once.
Zain: noted. skewer will be ceremonial only.
OpsBot: Match alert enabled. Goal and card updates will post in-channel.
Marta: Snack plan: I can bring grilled skewers (veg + chicken) or chips. whats the mood? react :drumstick: for skewers, :potato: for chips.
Eli: :drumstick:
Noemi: :potato:
Harper: :drumstick: (vote wins)
Zain: Skewers it is. I will assist with charcoal ambiance.
Laurie: (DM) Thanks for streaming me in! Ill cheer from Denver.
Harper: If penalties happen, karaoke order: 1) Noemi 2) Harper 3) Zain. that is the bracket so everyone practices their one-line scream.
Eli: Also tiny scoreboard: couch bets $1; winner gets skewer + brag GIF posted to #random.
OpsBot: 45': Halftime update  Riverstars 1 - 0 Harbor FC. Yellow card to Harbor FC (27').
Zain: YES on the yellow. Collecting $1s now.
Noemi: Where to hand over dollar? I have exact change in my sock drawer.
Harper: Drop in Marta's inbox or Venmo @MartaSnacks. I will verify with ceremonial handshake.
Marta: Received $3 so far for the yellow-card pool. Keep em coming.
Eli: Second-half watch rules: respectful cheering, no conga lines past 21:00, and zero skewering of keyboards.
Noemi: Agreed. also I will wear my lucky socks. they have literal confetti in them.
Harper: 89': Penalty awarded to Riverstars! karaoke imminent.
Zain: warming up cowbell.
OpsBot: 90'+2: Goal by Riverstars. Full time Riverstars 2 - 0 Harbor FC.
Eli: No penalties, no karaoke, but skewer goes to Zain for winning the yellow-card bet. ceremonial photos to follow.
Zain: I will accept the skewer humbly and post a photo with the tiny flags.
Marta: Trophy skewer will be engraved with "Couch League: Yellow Card Prophet" and then retired to the snack cabinet.
Noemi: Congrats Zain! I demand the brag GIF now.
Harper: GIF incoming: dramatic slow clap.
OpsBot: Reminder: Lounge cleanup requested after event. Recycling bins and napkins provided.
Eli: Thanks everyone. Next week: fantasy playoff draft night? whos in for late-night wings?
Noemi: count me in. I will bring lucky socks.
Harper: Ill bring tiny cowbells for good luck.
Zain: Ill defend my skewer if challenged.
Marta: Meeting adjourned. photos and GIFs will be uploaded shortly.
